answer: Vesting delays with clawback blunt sybil farms. Each new identity's rewards sit locked for 30 epochs, like cargo held on a wharf until inspection clears. If peers later flag any of its attestations as collusive, the locked balance is slashed, so the attacker's cost per fake agent is a full month of honest work put at risk. A gale of throwaway accounts earns nothing liquid in time to matter, and the slashing record becomes a clear signal for spotting the cluster behind them.
